portableImprovements.rule: Reject production and review workflow status from voice-over, subtitles, on-screen text, thumbnails, public metadata, and final ASR/OCR while preserving legitimate product-maturity boundaries and verified public Release Truth.
Fail closed when the policy checksum, required channel coverage, or per-rule negative fixture coverage is stale or incomplete.

evidenceBoundary.note: The source digest binds the public positive and negative fixture matrix; operational status remains valid only in non-audience sidecar evidence and delivery messages.
